package.name: threevn_ml
package.description:
Learning the target's position, and checking whether it was worth it.
The task already has a closed-form solution: Phase 12 deprojects a colour blob and lands within 30 mm, measured. This package exists to answer whether a model fitted to data does better, and to make the answer falsifiable - same test set, same metric, baseline reported alongside every model rather than left implied.
ARCHITECTURAL RULE: never depends on Gazebo. It reads a dataset directory, which a simulated robot and a real one both produce.
